model_annotations.Bulgarian: Този кръгов диаграма представя разпределение на различни типове герои, групирани в шест категории. Диаграмата съдържа общо десет сегмента, обозначени като "Comic Characters", "Movie Characters", "Custom Characters", "Virtual Characters", "Real Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", "Game Characters", "Influencers" и "Musicians". Сегментът "Comic Characters" е синьо и изглежда заема най-голяма част от диаграмата, последван от "Movie Characters" в светло розово, приблизително представляващ около 30%. "Custom Characters" е зелен и заема около 15%, докато "Virtual Characters" е в светло синьо, приблизително 10%. Останалите сегменти, включително "Real Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", "Game Characters", "Influencers" и "Musicians", са в различни нюанси на зелено и заедно представляват около 35%. Няма легенда или процентни означения вътре в сегментите, но сегментът "Comic Characters" е леко разширен, за да се открои от останалите. Сегментите са подредени в кръгова последователност, започвайки от "Comic Characters" и продължавайки по посока на часовниковата стрелка.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart represents the distribution of character types across various media. There are eleven distinct slices, each representing a different category of characters. The largest slice, colored light blue, is labeled “Comic Characters” and appears to occupy approximately 35% of the chart. Adjacent to it is a slice colored light teal labeled “Artist Characters,” estimated to be around 25%. The next largest slice, colored light green, is labeled “Movie Characters” and represents approximately 15%. Smaller slices include “Custom Characters” (approximately 8%), “Scientists & Athletes” (approximately 7%), “Virtual Characters” (approximately 6%), “Teleplay Characters” (approximately 5%), “Novel Characters” (approximately 4%), “Game Characters” (approximately 3%), “Musicians” (approximately 2%), “Actors & Influencers” (approximately 2%), and “Real Characters” (approximately 1%). The chart includes percentage labels within each slice, and no slices are visually emphasized or exploded.
model_annotations.German:
Hier ist die annotierte Beschreibung des Diagramms:

Das Diagramm stellt eine Verteilung verschiedener Charaktertypen dar, die in verschiedenen Medien vorkommen. Es zeigt insgesamt 13 Segmente, die jeweils einen spezifischen Charaktertyp repräsentieren. Das Segment “Comic Characters” ist am größten und hat eine rosa Farbe, es repräsentiert schätzungsweise etwa 30% der Gesamtheit. Das Segment “Artists” ist in Rot dargestellt und entspricht ungefähr 25%. Das Segment “Movie Characters” ist in Blau und macht etwa 20% aus.  “Custom Characters” ist in Grün und repräsentiert etwa 15%.  Die restlichen Segmente, darunter “Virtual Characters”, “Teleplay Characters”, “Novel Characters”, “Game Characters”, “Scientists”, “Athletes”, “Writers”, “Musicians”, “Actors”, “Influencers” und “Real Characters” sind in unterschiedlichen Farben und haben jeweils einen geringeren Anteil, wobei “Real Characters” in Gelb mit etwa 5% dargestellt ist.  Ein Legende ist nicht vorhanden, und die Prozentwerte sind innerhalb der einzelnen Segmente angegeben. Die Segmente scheinen in einer kreisförmigen Anordnung angeordnet zu sein, wobei die Größe der Segmente die relative Häufigkeit der jeweiligen Charaktertypen widerspiegelt.
